description: Purchase a domain for one year using the stored payment method. Needs a WHOIS contact: the one saved at namemy.app/app/settings, or pass `contact`. A `contact_required` error lists the missing fields to collect from the user. Pass `connect` to also point it at a deployment (Vercel, Netlify, Cloudflare Pages, GitHub Pages, Render, Railway, Fly) in the same call. [Requires a free namemy.app API key — get one at https://namemy.app/app/api-keys]

connect.description: Optional: after the purchase succeeds, point the domain at this deployment (same as connect_domain). It is validated before anything is bought; its result is reported under `connect`, and a connect failure does not undo the purchase.

value.description: The platform's hostname for the deployment: my-site.netlify.app, my-app.pages.dev, octocat.github.io, my-app.onrender.com, the *.up.railway.app target Railway shows after you add the domain there, or the my-app.fly.dev hostname / public IP from `fly certs setup`. Optional for vercel (only if its dashboard shows a *.vercel-dns*.com CNAME for www).

contact.description: Registrant contact. Overrides the saved contact.

name: buy_domain
